This walkthrough shows the configuration for the locked liver workflow. Supply
the external pixel data, region labels, feature masses and identifiers, reference
libraries, and pathway mappings. These resources are distributed separately.
The package's locked configuration records the relative resource paths and
checksums. Set `MSIDATASET_D15_STUDY_ROOT`, `MSIDATASET_D15_REFERENCE_ROOT`,
and `MSIDATASET_D15_DATA_ROOT` to the matching archive directories.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(msidataset)

dir.create("spectral-output", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("mfc-output", showWarnings = FALSE)
config <- list(
  input = list(path = "liver_roi.csv", format = "csv", mz = mz,
               feature_id = feature_id),
  labels = "labels.tsv",
  spectral = list(output_dir = "spectral-output", workers = 4),
  vector_library = "vector-library",
  mfc_output_dir = "mfc-output",
  evidence = list(output_dir = "full-evidence",
                  hmdb_pathways = "pathways.tsv",
                  reactome_mapping = "hmdb_reactome.tsv")
)
result <- run_pipeline(config, to = "build_llm_evidence", cache_dir = "cache")
result$selection$table
result$clusters$stability
result$neighbors$merged
result$evidence$views
```

Each checkpoint records its inputs, the package code, and the preceding checkpoint.
With the same inputs, call `run_pipeline()` again to reuse completed work. Use
`from` to start at a specific stage after valid earlier checkpoints.

MFC scores, candidate ranks, and semantic neighbor similarity measure support
under their respective scoring rules. Keep reference labels, gold standards,
author names and formulas, and evaluation truth out of model inputs. Within one
section, paired spatial blocks quantify regional differences at the section level.
